sections.text_helper: Section 27.6.3 "Baud rate register (USART_BRR)" in chapter 27 (Universal synchronous asynchronous receiver transmitter (USART)), RM0008 Rev 21, page 820.
sections.section_content:
Note: The baud counters stop counting if the TE or RE bits are disabled respectively.
Address offset: 0x08
Reset value: 0x0000
Reserved
Bits 31:16 Reserved, forced by hardware to 0.
Bits 15:4 DIV_Mantissa[11:0]: mantissa of USARTDIV
These 12 bits define the mantissa of the USART Divider (USARTDIV)
Bits 3:0 DIV_Fraction[3:0]: fraction of USARTDIV
These 4 bits define the fraction of the USART Divider (USARTDIV)
